mapper.select: SELECT id FROM admin_role WHERE role_code=#{code}
SELECT scope_type FROM admin_role_data_scope WHERE role_id=#{roleId} ORDER BY scope_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_user WHERE id=#{userId}
SELECT merchant_id FROM admin_user_merchant_scope WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY merchant_id

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant WHERE merchant_id IN #{id} AND status='ACTIVE'

mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_role_data_scope ds JOIN admin_role r ON r.id=ds.role_id JOIN admin_user_role ur ON ur.role_id=r.id JOIN admin_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND ds.scope_type='ALL')

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM merchant m WHERE m.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_role ur JOIN admin_role_data_scope ds ON ds.role_id=ur.role_id JOIN admin_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE u.username=#{username} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND ds.scope_type='ALL') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_user_merchant_scope ums JOIN admin_user u ON u.id=ums.user_id WHERE u.username=#{username} AND ums.merchant_id=m.merchant_id)))
